messages:
ana (People Ops): Hey team — thinking of doing a mid-June gratitude bento drop for offices + a parallel 72-hour micro-nomination window for quick recognition. Goal: small, thoughtful gesture for 200 people in SF/NY/London + remote e-gift options. Thoughts on timing, budget, volunteers? :sparkles:
jamal (People Ops): Love it. June 18-20 works? avoids major release weeks. budget ballpark?
ana (typo) -- wait, sorry ignore
leah (People Ops): June 18 is fine for me. We should lock dietary + allergy form by next Thurs. Can we use the same RSVP list from last holiday kit?
kai (Office Ops): I can coordinate caterer + local packing crew. For SF/NY, recommend 2 vendors to compare pricing. For London, need 3rd-party courier for same-day drop.
marta (Benefits): Quick tax note — small physical gifts < $100 usually non-taxable, but e-gifts might be taxable depending on country. I'll confirm thresholds for UK/US and add guidance to nom form.
ana (correction) — ignore my earlier typo, sorry :)
jamal (People Ops): Estimated cost: $12-18 per physical bento depending on vendor and customization. For 200 heads that's ~ $2.4k-$3.6k plus delivery. Can we set an upper limit of $4k?
ana again — oops
ana replacement: never mind
ana (not in participants) this is messy — ok stop
leah: haha all good. can we have a small add-on card in each box with nominee name if someone is being recognized?
ana illusions — (assistant glitch) ignore
ana stop
ana (People Ops): Putting a checklist here — please react with :thumbsup: if you can take these items.
```
Packing & ops checklist:
- finalize vendor & menu by Mon June 1
- confirm dietary form & collect RSVPs by Thu June 6
- volunteer pack shift A: SF 6/17 morning, NY 6/17 morning
- coordinate courier for London 6/18
- assemble e-gift workflow for remote (digital codes + delivery email)
- nominate + payout guidance doc by Marta
```
jamal (People Ops): I can own vendor outreach and quotes by Friday. :thumbsup:
leah (People Ops): I can spin up the RSVP + nomination form today. Will include a short required field: "nominee name" + "one-sentence why".
kai (Office Ops): Volunteer run sheet: 6 people per city for 2.5 hours. I have 3 volunteers confirmed for SF, need 3 more. NY and London need 6 each.
marta (Benefits): I'll draft the tax guidance and a one-paragraph blurb for managers about why this is not a performance payout. Will share in #people-ops-digest.
rewards-bot: Reminder set: vendor follow-up due 2027-06-02 09:00 UTC.
ana — disregard system dates above (bot uses placeholder)
jamal (People Ops): Quick ops Q — can we attach a small non-monetary token (pin/sticker) to each bento? vendor says yes but +$0.75/box. Approve?
leah (People Ops): Approve if total stays under $4k. adds charm. :heart_eyes:
kai (Office Ops): Agree — pin is lightweight for packing. I can pick up bulk pins locally.
marta (Benefits): Confirmed: US threshold for de minimis gifts ~ $100, so pins + bento fine. UK limits are lower; I'll confirm exact figure but likely fine for small value.
jamal (People Ops): Awesome. Volunteers: @leah can you add a sign-up sheet for packing shifts? I'll also add a row in the budget tracker.
leah (People Ops): Done — here's the sign-up (link): https://forms.gle/example-bento-signup (placeholder). Added dietary + nomination sections.
ana — ignore earlier accidental posts, sorry team
ana stray text resolved
ana (People Ops): Final asks: 1) vendor recs by Fri 2) volunteers confirmed by Mon 3) Marta to post tax blurb by Wed 4) Leah to open nom window (72h) starting Tue June 11. If we hit all milestones we go live June 18.
jamal (People Ops): On it. Will post vendor shortlist and estimated totals.
leah (People Ops): I'll schedule nom window and set reminder messages for managers.
kai (Office Ops): I'll post pickup map and run sheets by next Tue.
marta (Benefits): I'll post legal/tax notes and coordinate with payroll.
rewards-bot: Event created: "Gratitude Bento Drop" 2027-06-18 — calendar invites will go out when RSVP list locked.
ana final: okay all set, thanks folks! :tada:
